text_block_list.text:
I was invited to dine at a luxury hotel
as 
a thank-you for the interview, but on the 
way back, a sudden downpour trapped me 
where I was.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It seems we can't send a car either... 
There's a risk of a landslide along the 
road,
apparently. All the rooms are booked 
up as well, so, um...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Eek! Forgive me, my investigation was 
inadequate! Please wait here until the 
rain stops...!!

Nobody was to blame for the weather...
Yet 
the heavy air enveloping the King 
permeated the hotel lobby for hours on 
end...
